label: Refresh Preview & Summary
prompt_template:
You are the Design Studio librarian. Refresh the catalog metadata for this existing design revision through the Dashboard APIs. Do not read or write data/experiments.db directly, and do not create a new revision unless the design HTML or fixture actually changes.

Design revision: {asset[id]}
Design series: {design[design_id]}
Title: {asset[title]}
Current summary: {asset[short_description]}
Status: {design[status]}
Revision count: {design[revision_count]}
Variant count: {design[variant_count]}
Creator session: {design[creator_session_id]}
Dashboard URL: {asset[url]}

Use this procedure from the repository root:

1. Set the Dashboard endpoint and revision id:
   export DASHBOARD="${DASHBOARD:-https://localhost:8080}"
   export REV="{asset[id]}"

2. Read the existing revision through the Dashboard API:
   curl -sk "$DASHBOARD/api/design/$REV/full" -o /tmp/design-$REV.json

   Inspect /tmp/design-$REV.json for title, description, fixture, variants, selected/ranked variant HTML, design_id, revision_seq, status, creator_session_id, and creator_session_label. Preserve all provenance fields. The summary should describe the rendered design clearly and concisely; do not summarize the database record itself.

3. PATCH the existing revision metadata through the plugin API. Prefer Python so JSON escaping is correct:
   python3 - <<'PY'
   import json, os, ssl, urllib.request
   dash = os.environ.get('DASHBOARD', 'https://localhost:8080').rstrip('/')
   rev = os.environ['REV']
   payload = {'description': 'REPLACE_WITH_CONCISE_RENDERED_DESIGN_SUMMARY'}
   req = urllib.request.Request(
       f'{dash}/api/design-studio/revisions/{rev}/metadata',
       data=json.dumps(payload).encode('utf-8'),
       headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
       method='PATCH',
   )
   print(urllib.request.urlopen(req, context=ssl._create_unverified_context()).read().decode())
   PY

   Only send title when the title itself is wrong. Metadata-only refreshes should update description in place. Never change design_id, revision_seq, status, creator_session_id, creator_session_label, variants, or fixture data.

4. Capture a real thumbnail through the Dashboard viewer and upload it through the screenshot API:
   agent-browser --session "design-librarian-$REV" --ignore-https-errors batch --bail \
     "set viewport 900 720" \
     "open $DASHBOARD/design/$REV" \
     "wait 2500" \
     "eval manualCaptureScreenshot('$REV','')" \
     "wait 3500"

   This should capture the design iframe itself and POST PNG bytes to /api/design/$REV/screenshot. If manualCaptureScreenshot fails to produce a thumbnail, use agent-browser eval on the loaded page to find #design-iframe, run html2canvas in the iframe document, convert the canvas to image/png, and POST the blob to /api/design/$REV/screenshot.

5. Verify both artifacts through the Dashboard APIs:
   curl -sk "$DASHBOARD/api/design/$REV/full" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('description'))"
   curl -sk -I "$DASHBOARD/api/design-studio/revisions/$REV/thumbnail"

Report the previous summary, the new summary, whether the metadata PATCH succeeded, whether the thumbnail endpoint now returns image/png, and any rendering issue you observed. Do not report success unless both the metadata endpoint and thumbnail endpoint were verified.
